Class LeaderboardManager

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.LeaderBoard.LeaderboardManager
public class LeaderboardManager extends Object
Manages leaderboard entries by saving scores to a text file, loading them back into memory, and sorting them in descending order.

The leaderboard is persisted in a simple text file where each entry is stored as: playerName;score;gameMode;timestamp.

  • Method Details

    • saveEntry

      public void saveEntry(ScoreEntry entry) throws IOException
      Saves a new score entry to the leaderboard file. Each entry is appended in the format: playerName;score;gameMode;timestamp.
      Parameters:
      entry - the score entry to save
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing to the file fails

    • loadEntries

      public List<ScoreEntry> loadEntries() throws IOException
      Loads all score entries from the leaderboard file.

      If the file does not exist, an empty list is returned. Entries are parsed and sorted in descending order by score.

      Returns:
      a list of score entries sorted by score (highest first)
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading from the file fails
